lead_raw_text:
The structure of HfHg₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing six atoms (Hf₂Hg₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Hf centers coordinated by nine Hg neighbors, while Hg centers adopt 8-, 9-, and 10-neighbor environments, the latter described as a 10-vertex coordination polyhedron. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Hg polyhedra and between Hf and Hg polyhedra, with the geometric neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
